All training curves and transfer matrices

27 source models · 243 evaluation cells · seed 0 · nonzero features · Ukraine/COVID one-hop 500k-node minis.

Blue: training loss averaged over 100 updates. Orange: source-validation loss every 2,000 updates. ★: selected checkpoint. Checkpoint selection uses source validation; final and selected updates appear on each panel. Matrix rows are training sources; columns are evaluation targets; orange outlines mark same-graph cells.

Metrics: FR uses squared cosine reconstruction error. LP curves use 1:5 positive/negative sampling; LP matrices now also use uniform independent-endpoint negatives at 1:5, rejecting all known edges and self-loops. Raw BCE is on the same class ratio as the curves; constant-p=1/6 baseline BCE is 0.4506. A separate balanced-test BCE is retained in the CSVs. AUC/BCE color scales are shared between the two LP matrices.

Corrected neighbor protocol: The original 70% training-edge pool is split equally into context-only edges and positive supervision edges. No positive training pair appears in neighbor context. Positive validation/test edges are unchanged. Negative evaluation pairs have been replaced with uniform samples. Mean selected-checkpoint train–validation gap: 0.0315 → 0.0051 (84% smaller).
